consequence.statement: OCIRepository objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Ensure OCIRepository objects written against source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 carry status.artifact.digest; review any manifests or tooling that write these objects without the controller-managed status artifact digest populated.

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of OCIRepository, the field status.artifact.digest is newly required, and objects that omit it are rejected.
